meta.title: Antigravity Executor
meta.description: Delegate coding tasks to the signed-in Antigravity desktop agent and watch every turn live in a War Room dashboard. The dashboard is one implementation with two ways in: the Antigravity icon in the dsh sidebar, and the standalone page on http://127.0.0.1:18420 — the in-app panel renders that very page through dsh's same-origin proxy, so both show the same DOM, the same features, and follow the host's light/dark theme. It provides a five-stage lifecycle stepper, a streaming tool-call timeline that badges each step clean, hanging, workspace-escape or blocked-destructive, dual-window account quota gauges (5h and weekly) with reset countdowns and reserve marker lines, one-click emergency abort and cooldown skip, hot runtime policy switches, session management with eviction, brain artifact browsing, and a live HTML/3D preview split pane that refreshes when a turn settles. The console is served by a zero-dependency node:http + SSE server that frees its port on reload. Also keeps the adaptive surgical/creative task mode with a Pass-1 visual gate, RPC-driven settlement that returns within seconds, an in-process serial queue, untruncated long reports, quota guards with a 24h floor, a destructive-vs-escape kill switch, human-like inter-turn pacing, dead-session self-heal, a 60s hanging-command circuit breaker and a git snapshot inlined into every result.
